title: How a Godly Man Kills His Oldest Excuse
caption:
Procrastination isn't laziness. It's fear wearing a to-do list.

The job you keep avoiding usually names what you're actually afraid of: rejection, failure, being seen and found average. You don't beat that by trying harder. You beat it by doing the ugly first draft, setting a deadline a brother can hold you to, and calling the excuse what it is before it becomes who you are.

Whatever you don't kill, you eventually become.
